diff --git a/durability.go b/durability.go
new file mode 100644
index 00000000..1a58036f
--- /dev/null
+++ b/durability.go
@@ -0,0 +1,427 @@
+// Copyright 2026 The LevelDB-Go and Pebble Authors. All rights reserved. Use
+// of this source code is governed by a BSD-style license that can be found in
+// the LICENSE file.
+
+package pebble
+
+import (
+	"container/heap"
+	"context"
+	"sync"
+	"sync/atomic"
+	"time"
+
+	"github.com/cockroachdb/crlib/crtime"
+	"github.com/cockroachdb/errors"
+	"github.com/cockroachdb/pebble/internal/base"
+)
+
+// ErrDurabilityJobExpired is returned by DB.WaitForJobDurability when the job
+// ID is older than the retention window of tracked durability jobs.
+var ErrDurabilityJobExpired = errors.New("pebble: durability job expired")
+
+// ErrDurabilityJobUnknown is returned by DB.WaitForJobDurability when the job
+// ID was never allocated.
+var ErrDurabilityJobUnknown = errors.New("pebble: unknown durability job")
+
+// ErrTooManyDurabilitySubscriptions is delivered on the channel returned by
+// DB.DurabilityNotify when the number of outstanding subscriptions exceeds
+// the limit.
+var ErrTooManyDurabilitySubscriptions = errors.New("pebble: too many outstanding durability subscriptions")
+
+const (
+	// durabilityJobRetention is the number of most recent durability jobs for
+	// which the outcome is retained for DB.WaitForJobDurability.
+	durabilityJobRetention = 4096
+	// maxDurabilitySubscriptions bounds the number of outstanding (not yet
+	// resolved) DB.DurabilityNotify subscriptions.
+	maxDurabilitySubscriptions = 1 << 14
+)
+
+// DurabilityStats is a snapshot of the durability tracking state of a DB.
+type DurabilityStats struct {
+	// HighestDurableSeqNum is the highest sequence number known to be durable
+	// in the WAL.
+	HighestDurableSeqNum base.SeqNum
+	// FirstErr is the first WAL sync error encountered, if any.
+	FirstErr error
+	// PendingWaiters is the number of goroutines currently blocked in the
+	// durability wait APIs.
+	PendingWaiters int64
+	// TotalDurableCommits is the number of Sync commits that became durable.
+	TotalDurableCommits uint64
+	// TotalFailedCommits is the number of Sync commits that failed.
+	TotalFailedCommits uint64
+	// CumulativeSyncDuration is the cumulative WAL sync duration of successful
+	// Sync commits.
+	CumulativeSyncDuration time.Duration
+	// MaxSyncDuration is the maximum WAL sync duration of a successful Sync
+	// commit.
+	MaxSyncDuration time.Duration
+}
+
+// batchDurableState holds the per-batch state needed to produce a
+// BatchDurable notification for a Sync commit.
+type batchDurableState struct {
+	// db is set when a Sync commit via ApplyNoSyncWait is awaiting
+	// Batch.SyncWait, which delivers the notification.
+	db            *DB
+	correlationID uint64
+	batchSize     int
+	applyDuration time.Duration
+	// syncStart is the time at which the batch was written to the WAL.
+	syncStart    crtime.Mono
+	syncDuration time.Duration
+}
+
+type durabilityWaiter struct {
+	seqNum base.SeqNum
+	ch     chan error
+	// index is the position in the heap, or -1 once the waiter is resolved or
+	// removed.
+	index  int
+	notify bool
+}
+
+type durabilityWaiterHeap []*durabilityWaiter
+
+func (h durabilityWaiterHeap) Len() int           { return len(h) }
+func (h durabilityWaiterHeap) Less(i, j int) bool { return h[i].seqNum < h[j].seqNum }
+func (h durabilityWaiterHeap) Swap(i, j int) {
+	h[i], h[j] = h[j], h[i]
+	h[i].index = i
+	h[j].index = j
+}
+func (h *durabilityWaiterHeap) Push(x any) {
+	w := x.(*durabilityWaiter)
+	w.index = len(*h)
+	*h = append(*h, w)
+}
+func (h *durabilityWaiterHeap) Pop() any {
+	old := *h
+	n := len(old)
+	w := old[n-1]
+	old[n-1] = nil
+	w.index = -1
+	*h = old[:n-1]
+	return w
+}
+
+type durabilityJob struct {
+	id  int
+	err error
+}
+
+// durabilityTracker tracks the highest durable sequence number of a DB and
+// the goroutines and subscriptions waiting on it.
+//
+// A WAL sync that covers a batch also covers every WAL record written before
+// it, and sequence numbers are allocated in the same order that records are
+// written to the WAL. So when a Sync commit becomes durable, every sequence
+// number up to and including its last sequence number is durable.
+type durabilityTracker struct {
+	// disabled is set when the WAL is disabled, in which case all waits
+	// succeed immediately.
+	disabled       bool
+	pendingWaiters atomic.Int64
+
+	mu struct {
+		sync.Mutex
+		durable  base.SeqNum
+		firstErr error
+		closeErr error
+		waiters  durabilityWaiterHeap
+		// notifySubs is the number of outstanding DurabilityNotify
+		// subscriptions in waiters.
+		notifySubs int
+
+		totalDurable uint64
+		totalFailed  uint64
+		cumSync      time.Duration
+		maxSync      time.Duration
+
+		// lastJobID is the most recently allocated job ID. Job IDs start at 1.
+		lastJobID int
+		jobs      [durabilityJobRetention]durabilityJob
+	}
+}
+
+// resolvedLocked returns the outcome of waiting for seqNum if it is already
+// determined.
+func (t *durabilityTracker) resolvedLocked(seqNum base.SeqNum) (err error, done bool) {
+	switch {
+	case seqNum <= t.mu.durable:
+		return nil, true
+	case t.mu.firstErr != nil:
+		return t.mu.firstErr, true
+	case t.mu.closeErr != nil:
+		return t.mu.closeErr, true
+	}
+	return nil, false
+}
+
+func (t *durabilityTracker) wait(ctx context.Context, seqNum base.SeqNum) error {
+	if t.disabled {
+		return nil
+	}
+	t.mu.Lock()
+	if err, done := t.resolvedLocked(seqNum); done {
+		t.mu.Unlock()
+		return err
+	}
+	if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
+		t.mu.Unlock()
+		return err
+	}
+	w := &durabilityWaiter{seqNum: seqNum, ch: make(chan error, 1)}
+	heap.Push(&t.mu.waiters, w)
+	t.pendingWaiters.Add(1)
+	t.mu.Unlock()
+	defer t.pendingWaiters.Add(-1)
+
+	select {
+	case err := <-w.ch:
+		return err
+	case <-ctx.Done():
+	}
+	t.mu.Lock()
+	if w.index >= 0 {
+		heap.Remove(&t.mu.waiters, w.index)
+		t.mu.Unlock()
+		return ctx.Err()
+	}
+	t.mu.Unlock()
+	// The waiter was resolved concurrently with the context being canceled;
+	// the durability outcome takes precedence.
+	return <-w.ch
+}
+
+func (t *durabilityTracker) notify(seqNum base.SeqNum) <-chan error {
+	ch := make(chan error, 1)
+	if t.disabled {
+		ch <- nil
+		return ch
+	}
+	t.mu.Lock()
+	defer t.mu.Unlock()
+	if err, done := t.resolvedLocked(seqNum); done {
+		ch <- err
+		return ch
+	}
+	if t.mu.notifySubs >= maxDurabilitySubscriptions {
+		ch <- ErrTooManyDurabilitySubscriptions
+		return ch
+	}
+	t.mu.notifySubs++
+	heap.Push(&t.mu.waiters, &durabilityWaiter{seqNum: seqNum, ch: ch, notify: true})
+	return ch
+}
+
+func (t *durabilityTracker) waitJob(jobID int) error {
+	if t.disabled {
+		return nil
+	}
+	t.mu.Lock()
+	defer t.mu.Unlock()
+	if jobID <= 0 || jobID > t.mu.lastJobID {
+		return errors.Wrapf(ErrDurabilityJobUnknown, "job %d", errors.Safe(jobID))
+	}
+	if jobID <= t.mu.lastJobID-durabilityJobRetention {
+		return errors.Wrapf(ErrDurabilityJobExpired, "job %d", errors.Safe(jobID))
+	}
+	// Job IDs are allocated when the durability outcome of a commit is known,
+	// so a retained job is always resolved.
+	j := &t.mu.jobs[jobID%durabilityJobRetention]
+	if j.id != jobID {
+		return errors.AssertionFailedf("durability job %d not found (slot holds %d)",
+			errors.Safe(jobID), errors.Safe(j.id))
+	}
+	return j.err
+}
+
+// record records the outcome of a Sync commit whose last sequence number is
+// lastSeqNum, wakes any resolved waiters and returns the allocated job ID.
+func (t *durabilityTracker) record(
+	lastSeqNum base.SeqNum, err error, syncDuration time.Duration,
+) int {
+	t.mu.Lock()
+	defer t.mu.Unlock()
+	t.mu.lastJobID++
+	jobID := t.mu.lastJobID
+	t.mu.jobs[jobID%durabilityJobRetention] = durabilityJob{id: jobID, err: err}
+	if err == nil {
+		t.mu.durable = max(t.mu.durable, lastSeqNum)
+		t.mu.totalDurable++
+		t.mu.cumSync += syncDuration
+		t.mu.maxSync = max(t.mu.maxSync, syncDuration)
+	} else {
+		t.mu.totalFailed++
+		if t.mu.firstErr == nil {
+			t.mu.firstErr = err
+		}
+	}
+	for len(t.mu.waiters) > 0 {
+		werr, done := t.resolvedLocked(t.mu.waiters[0].seqNum)
+		if !done {
+			break
+		}
+		t.resolveLocked(heap.Pop(&t.mu.waiters).(*durabilityWaiter), werr)
+	}
+	return jobID
+}
+
+// close fails all outstanding waiters and subscriptions with err, as well as
+// any future waits that are not already satisfied.
+func (t *durabilityTracker) close(err error) {
+	t.mu.Lock()
+	defer t.mu.Unlock()
+	if t.mu.closeErr == nil {
+		t.mu.closeErr = err
+	}
+	for len(t.mu.waiters) > 0 {
+		w := heap.Pop(&t.mu.waiters).(*durabilityWaiter)
+		werr, _ := t.resolvedLocked(w.seqNum)
+		t.resolveLocked(w, werr)
+	}
+}
+
+func (t *durabilityTracker) resolveLocked(w *durabilityWaiter, err error) {
+	if w.notify {
+		t.mu.notifySubs--
+	}
+	w.ch <- err
+}
+
+func (t *durabilityTracker) state() (base.SeqNum, error) {
+	t.mu.Lock()
+	defer t.mu.Unlock()
+	return t.mu.durable, t.mu.firstErr
+}
+
+func (t *durabilityTracker) stats() DurabilityStats {
+	t.mu.Lock()
+	defer t.mu.Unlock()
+	return DurabilityStats{
+		HighestDurableSeqNum:   t.mu.durable,
+		FirstErr:               t.mu.firstErr,
+		PendingWaiters:         t.pendingWaiters.Load(),
+		TotalDurableCommits:    t.mu.totalDurable,
+		TotalFailedCommits:     t.mu.totalFailed,
+		CumulativeSyncDuration: t.mu.cumSync,
+		MaxSyncDuration:        t.mu.maxSync,
+	}
+}
+
+// notifyBatchDurable records the durability outcome of a Sync commit of b and
+// invokes the BatchDurable event listener. It must be called exactly once per
+// Sync commit, after the WAL sync covering the batch has completed.
+func (d *DB) notifyBatchDurable(b *Batch, err error) {
+	if d.opts.DisableWAL {
+		return
+	}
+	s := &b.durable
+	applyDuration, syncDuration := s.applyDuration, s.syncDuration
+	if err == nil {
+		// Guarantee strictly positive durations for successful commits even
+		// with a coarse clock.
+		applyDuration = max(applyDuration, 1)
+		syncDuration = max(syncDuration, 1)
+	}
+	seqNum := b.SeqNum()
+	lastSeqNum := seqNum
+	if n := b.Count(); n > 0 {
+		lastSeqNum = seqNum + base.SeqNum(n) - 1
+	}
+	jobID := d.durability.record(lastSeqNum, err, syncDuration)
+	if !d.batchDurableConfigured {
+		return
+	}
+	if err == nil {
+		d.durableCommitCount.Add(1)
+		d.durableCommitDuration.Add(int64(syncDuration))
+	}
+	d.opts.EventListener.BatchDurable(BatchDurableInfo{
+		JobID:         jobID,
+		SeqNum:        seqNum,
+		Err:           err,
+		ApplyDuration: applyDuration,
+		SyncDuration:  syncDuration,
+		CorrelationID: s.correlationID,
+		BatchSize:     s.batchSize,
+		KeyCount:      b.Count(),
+	})
+}
+
+// WaitForDurability blocks until seqNum is durable in the WAL. It returns an
+// error if a WAL sync fails or the DB is closed before seqNum becomes durable.
+// A zero seqNum is always durable. If the WAL is disabled, it returns nil
+// immediately.
+func (d *DB) WaitForDurability(seqNum base.SeqNum) error {
+	return d.durability.wait(context.Background(), seqNum)
+}
+
+// WaitForDurabilityContext is like WaitForDurability, but also returns when
+// ctx is canceled. A durability outcome (success, WAL sync failure or DB
+// close) takes precedence over context cancellation.
+func (d *DB) WaitForDurabilityContext(ctx context.Context, seqNum base.SeqNum) error {
+	return d.durability.wait(ctx, seqNum)
+}
+
+// WaitForDurabilityBatch blocks until every sequence number in seqNums is
+// durable. It returns nil if seqNums is empty.
+func (d *DB) WaitForDurabilityBatch(seqNums []base.SeqNum) error {
+	return d.WaitForDurabilityBatchContext(context.Background(), seqNums)
+}
+
+// WaitForDurabilityBatchContext is like WaitForDurabilityBatch, but also
+// returns when ctx is canceled.
+func (d *DB) WaitForDurabilityBatchContext(ctx context.Context, seqNums []base.SeqNum) error {
+	if len(seqNums) == 0 {
+		return nil
+	}
+	// Durability is monotonic, so waiting for the maximum suffices.
+	var m base.SeqNum
+	for _, s := range seqNums {
+		m = max(m, s)
+	}
+	return d.durability.wait(ctx, m)
+}
+
+// WaitForJobDurability waits for the Sync commit identified by the
+// BatchDurableInfo.JobID jobID to become durable, returning its outcome. Only
+// the most recent durability jobs are retained; older jobs return an error
+// wrapping ErrDurabilityJobExpired. Job IDs that were never allocated
+// (including zero) return an error wrapping ErrDurabilityJobUnknown.
+func (d *DB) WaitForJobDurability(jobID int) error {
+	return d.durability.waitJob(jobID)
+}
+
+// WaitForJobDurabilityContext is like WaitForJobDurability, but also returns
+// when ctx is canceled.
+func (d *DB) WaitForJobDurabilityContext(ctx context.Context, jobID int) error {
+	// Job IDs are only allocated once a commit's outcome is known, so waiting
+	// never blocks and the outcome always takes precedence over ctx.
+	return d.durability.waitJob(jobID)
+}
+
+// DurableState returns the highest durable sequence number and the first WAL
+// sync error encountered, if any.
+func (d *DB) DurableState() (base.SeqNum, error) {
+	return d.durability.state()
+}
+
+// DurabilityNotify returns a channel that receives a single value once
+// seqNum's durability outcome is known: nil once seqNum is durable, or a
+// non-nil error if a WAL sync fails or the DB is closed first. If the outcome
+// is already known, the returned channel is pre-filled. The number of
+// outstanding subscriptions is bounded; once the bound is reached, the
+// returned channel is pre-filled with ErrTooManyDurabilitySubscriptions. If
+// the WAL is disabled, the channel is pre-filled with nil.
+func (d *DB) DurabilityNotify(seqNum base.SeqNum) <-chan error {
+	return d.durability.notify(seqNum)
+}
+
+// DurabilityStats returns a snapshot of the DB's durability tracking state.
+func (d *DB) DurabilityStats() DurabilityStats {
+	return d.durability.stats()
+}
diff --git a/durability_test.go b/durability_test.go
new file mode 100644
index 00000000..4266f8ca
--- /dev/null
+++ b/durability_test.go
@@ -0,0 +1,283 @@
+// Copyright 2026 The LevelDB-Go and Pebble Authors. All rights reserved. Use
+// of this source code is governed by a BSD-style license that can be found in
+// the LICENSE file.
+
+package pebble
+
+import (
+	"context"
+	"fmt"
+	"strings"
+	"sync"
+	"sync/atomic"
+	"testing"
+	"time"
+
+	"github.com/cockroachdb/errors"
+	"github.com/cockroachdb/pebble/internal/base"
+	"github.com/cockroachdb/pebble/vfs"
+	"github.com/cockroachdb/pebble/vfs/errorfs"
+	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
+)
+
+type batchDurableRecorder struct {
+	mu    sync.Mutex
+	infos []BatchDurableInfo
+}
+
+func (r *batchDurableRecorder) record(info BatchDurableInfo) {
+	r.mu.Lock()
+	defer r.mu.Unlock()
+	r.infos = append(r.infos, info)
+}
+
+func (r *batchDurableRecorder) get() []BatchDurableInfo {
+	r.mu.Lock()
+	defer r.mu.Unlock()
+	return append([]BatchDurableInfo(nil), r.infos...)
+}
+
+func openDurabilityTestDB(t *testing.T, l func(BatchDurableInfo), disableWAL bool) *DB {
+	opts := &Options{
+		FS:         vfs.NewMem(),
+		DisableWAL: disableWAL,
+		Logger:     testutilsLogger{t},
+	}
+	if l != nil {
+		opts.EventListener = &EventListener{BatchDurable: l}
+	}
+	d, err := Open("", opts)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	return d
+}
+
+type testutilsLogger struct{ t *testing.T }
+
+func (l testutilsLogger) Infof(format string, args ...interface{})  {}
+func (l testutilsLogger) Errorf(format string, args ...interface{}) {}
+func (l testutilsLogger) Fatalf(format string, args ...interface{}) {
+	l.t.Logf("fatal: "+format, args...)
+}
+
+func TestBatchDurableEvent(t *testing.T) {
+	var r batchDurableRecorder
+	d := openDurabilityTestDB(t, r.record, false)
+	defer func() { require.NoError(t, d.Close()) }()
+
+	// Non-sync commits never fire the event.
+	require.NoError(t, d.Set([]byte("a"), []byte("1"), NoSync))
+	require.Empty(t, r.get())
+
+	b := d.NewBatch()
+	require.NoError(t, b.Set([]byte("b"), []byte("2"), nil))
+	require.NoError(t, b.Set([]byte("c"), []byte("3"), nil))
+	size := len(b.Repr())
+	require.NoError(t, b.Commit(&WriteOptions{Sync: true, CommitCorrelationID: 42}))
+	seqNum := b.SeqNum()
+	require.NoError(t, b.Close())
+
+	infos := r.get()
+	require.Len(t, infos, 1)
+	info := infos[0]
+	require.NoError(t, info.Err)
+	require.Equal(t, 1, info.JobID)
+	require.Equal(t, seqNum, info.SeqNum)
+	require.Equal(t, uint64(42), info.CorrelationID)
+	require.Equal(t, size, info.BatchSize)
+	require.Equal(t, uint32(2), info.KeyCount)
+	require.Greater(t, info.ApplyDuration, time.Duration(0))
+	require.Greater(t, info.SyncDuration, time.Duration(0))

+func TestDurabilityWaitersAndClose(t *testing.T) {
+	d := openDurabilityTestDB(t, nil, false)
+	require.NoError(t, d.Set([]byte("a"), nil, Sync))
+	durable, _ := d.DurableState()
+
+	// A non-sync write is durable once a subsequent sync write is.
+	require.NoError(t, d.Set([]byte("b"), nil, NoSync))
+	target := durable + 1
+	ch := d.DurabilityNotify(target)
+	errCh := make(chan error, 1)
+	go func() { errCh <- d.WaitForDurability(target) }()
+	require.Eventually(t, func() bool { return d.DurabilityStats().PendingWaiters == 1 }, 10*time.Second, time.Millisecond)
+	select {
+	case <-ch:
+		t.Fatal("unexpected notification")
+	default:
+	}
+	require.NoError(t, d.Set([]byte("c"), nil, Sync))
+	require.NoError(t, <-ch)
+	require.NoError(t, <-errCh)
+	require.Equal(t, int64(0), d.DurabilityStats().PendingWaiters)
+
+	// Context cancellation.
+	ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
+	cancel()
+	require.ErrorIs(t, d.WaitForDurabilityContext(ctx, target+100), context.Canceled)
+	// An already-durable seqnum takes precedence over cancellation.
+	require.NoError(t, d.WaitForDurabilityContext(ctx, target))
+	ctx, cancel = context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 10*time.Millisecond)
+	defer cancel()
+	require.ErrorIs(t, d.WaitForDurabilityContext(ctx, target+100), context.DeadlineExceeded)
+	require.Equal(t, int64(0), d.DurabilityStats().PendingWaiters)
+
+	// Close unblocks waiters with an error.
+	ch = d.DurabilityNotify(target + 100)
+	go func() { errCh <- d.WaitForDurabilityContext(context.Background(), target+100) }()
+	require.Eventually(t, func() bool { return d.DurabilityStats().PendingWaiters == 1 }, 10*time.Second, time.Millisecond)
+	require.NoError(t, d.Close())
+	require.ErrorIs(t, <-errCh, ErrClosed)
+	require.ErrorIs(t, <-ch, ErrClosed)
+	require.ErrorIs(t, d.WaitForDurability(target+100), ErrClosed)
+	require.ErrorIs(t, <-d.DurabilityNotify(target+100), ErrClosed)
+}

+func TestBatchDurableSyncFailure(t *testing.T) {
+	var inject atomic.Bool
+	fs := errorfs.Wrap(vfs.NewMem(), errorfs.InjectorFunc(func(op errorfs.Op) error {
+		if inject.Load() && (op.Kind == errorfs.OpFileSync || op.Kind == errorfs.OpFileSyncData) &&
+			strings.HasSuffix(op.Path, ".log") {
+			return errorfs.ErrInjected
+		}
+		return nil
+	}))
+	var r batchDurableRecorder
+	var fatal atomic.Bool
+	d, err := Open("", &Options{
+		FS:            fs,
+		EventListener: &EventListener{BatchDurable: r.record},
+		Logger:        &mockLogger{fatalFunc: func(string, ...interface{}) { fatal.Store(true) }},
+	})
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	require.NoError(t, d.Set([]byte("a"), nil, Sync))
+	durable, _ := d.DurableState()
+	ch := d.DurabilityNotify(durable + 1)
+
+	inject.Store(true)
+	b := d.NewBatch()
+	require.NoError(t, b.Set([]byte("b"), nil, nil))
+	_ = d.Apply(b, Sync)
+	require.True(t, fatal.Load())
+
+	infos := r.get()
+	require.Len(t, infos, 2)
+	require.Error(t, infos[1].Err)
+	require.ErrorIs(t, <-ch, errorfs.ErrInjected)
+	_, firstErr := d.DurableState()
+	require.ErrorIs(t, firstErr, errorfs.ErrInjected)
+	require.ErrorIs(t, d.WaitForDurability(b.SeqNum()), errorfs.ErrInjected)
+	require.ErrorIs(t, d.WaitForJobDurability(infos[1].JobID), errorfs.ErrInjected)
+	require.NoError(t, d.WaitForDurability(durable))
+	s := d.DurabilityStats()
+	require.Equal(t, uint64(1), s.TotalDurableCommits)
+	require.Equal(t, uint64(1), s.TotalFailedCommits)
+	require.Equal(t, uint64(1), d.Metrics().DurableCommitCount)
+	inject.Store(false)
+	_ = d.Close()
+}

+func TestTeeBatchDurable(t *testing.T) {
+	e := TeeEventListener(EventListener{}, EventListener{})
+	require.False(t, batchDurableConfigured(e.BatchDurable))
+	var a, b int
+	e = TeeEventListener(EventListener{BatchDurable: func(BatchDurableInfo) { a++ }},
+		EventListener{BatchDurable: func(BatchDurableInfo) { b++ }})
+	require.True(t, batchDurableConfigured(e.BatchDurable))
+	e.BatchDurable(BatchDurableInfo{})
+	require.Equal(t, 1, a)
+	require.Equal(t, 1, b)
+	e = TeeEventListener(EventListener{}, EventListener{BatchDurable: func(BatchDurableInfo) { b++ }})
+	require.True(t, batchDurableConfigured(e.BatchDurable))
+	e.BatchDurable(BatchDurableInfo{})
+	require.Equal(t, 2, b)
+}
